mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name FROM sys_menu_role mr JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = mr.role_code AND r.status = 1 WHERE mr.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY r.order_num
SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status, mr.create_time, mr.update_time FROM sys_menu_role mr INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = mr.role_code WHERE mr.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT m.id, m.title, m.name, m.path, m.menu_type, m.status FROM sys_menu_role mr INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = mr.menu_id WHERE mr.role_code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY m.menu_rank, m.id
